name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2019-07-25.242.1) introduced by by Tasmanian Senator [Nick McKim](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) (Greens), which means it failed. Senator McKim [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2019-07-25.242.1): > *These amendments, importantly, would provide for crossbench membership on the Parliamentary Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security and help that committee to do its job, to scrutinise the ongoing march of this country down the road to a police state.*
